contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could be done and it was decided beforehand, yet our analysis found fixable issues and arrived three weeks late after the test finished.
Rep calls the account healthy and not on anyone's list, but there was no business review for 9-10 months and Stefan says he heard from Stripe only when he said he was leaving.
CFO approval came two weeks before the last call, but the rep learned of the evaluation only at the renewal notice, and says it was decided before we got in the room; timing is unclear.
Rep says nobody wanted to rip anything out, yet Stefan asked to split the contract and the international business went to local acquiring.
Rep had not met Stefan and did not know of his hire, yet describes his background, first actions and later calls with him.

dodges.question: Which ones? (which international markets)
dodges.what: Rep said she did not know exactly, named only Brazil and a couple in Europe, and never saw the analysis.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?
dodges.what: Rep said it was a renewal and they weren't pitching; named no part that got a reaction, only silence on the uplift number.

dodges.question: When did you first feel this was lost? What happened right before?
dodges.what: Rep said there was no moment and nothing to do, later contradicted by the late analysis, the missing named contact and the lack of reviews.

dodges.question: When was the last business review before that?
dodges.what: Rep hesitated, deflected to 'before I took the account', and gave an uncertain estimate of nine or ten months.

outcome_signals.what: Lost the international business to local acquiring.
